assumptions.statement: Official overall-design polygon is absent; the repository provisional polygon is only a temporary modeling envelope.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios and derived designs move when the official polygon arrives.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace site boundary, clip all design layers, recalculate metrics, figures and drawings.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional rectangles inferred by maintainers.
assumptions.impact: Detailed design locations and overlap with parcels/roads may change.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace all three together and rerun spatial review.

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership and municipal networks are missing.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, setback, buildability and cost cannot be confirmed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Professional teams import cleared controls before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: Repository issue #846 reports a gap between the provisional site polygon and mapped heritage-park context.
assumptions.impact: No exact heritage boundary or intervention is claimed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Use official heritage survey/control layers before locating physical work.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual reference massing, not an existing-building survey.
assumptions.impact: Coverage is a design-test metric only.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Survey retain/renovate/demolish status parcel by parcel.

assumptions.statement: Walking and cross-link centerlines do not represent approved roads or redlines.
assumptions.impact: Connections may cross ownership, level or safety constraints.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Confirm survey, accessibility, traffic and station-interface conditions.

assumptions.statement: No cleared municipal or energy network data is available.
assumptions.impact: Sponge, charging, edge-compute and power proposals remain principles.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete discipline coordination and capacity checks.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario nodes have no assigned operator, data controller or permit.
assumptions.impact: No live deployment is authorized by this proposal.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Require owner, impact assessment, human review, stop rule and public notice.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are mechanism references only.
assumptions.impact: Their governance, markets and planning systems are not equivalent to Beijing.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Test every transfer against local law, controls and users.

assumptions.statement: All rendered massing and experience imagery is conceptual.
assumptions.impact: Images are not evidence of current conditions or approved construction.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Keep captions and copyright statement attached in every public display.
